title: Rapid liaison capture and light-score
body:
Purpose: quick one-off cross-team contact directory + a tiny heuristic 'light-score' to triage who to ping for short coverage windows. Created because Friday incident left a few half-stale handoffs; this sheet is intended to be fast to scan and mutate during a cadence handoff or brief on-call sync.

How to use: paste into a lightweight sheet, sort by CurrentFlag then ResponseLagHrs. Ping people tagged with "priority" or "fragile" during the next 24h sweep. Review the score and mark any stale rows with "needs-rotation".

Quick table (columns): Liaison, PrimaryTeam, Region, LocalWindow, CoverageType, RecentPing, ResponseLagHrs, CurrentFlag, Notes

Rows:
Marcus Chen, serving-runtime, us-west, 08:00-12:00 PDT, full-route, 2029-07-11, 1.5, priority, holds burst-capacity handoff for dedicated pool A
Leah Kline, observability, eu-west, 14:00-18:00 CEST, telemetry, 2029-07-10, 6.0, healthy, runs latency sampling job; escalates to SRE if >10% errors
Anika Rao, product-ops, us-east, 09:00-17:00 EST, liaison, 2029-07-12, 0.5, priority, primary contact for rollout window; can reassign to Maya
Tom Becker, solutions-eng, apac, 10:00-14:00 SGT, customer-bridge, 2029-07-02, 72.0, fragile, intermittent coverage for enterprise pilots
Maya Ortiz, private-deployments, us-west, 07:00-11:00 PDT, security, 2029-06-30, 312.0, stale, needs new on-call rotation added
Jia Park, release-engineering, eu-central, 13:00-17:00 CEST, release-window, 2029-07-09, 48.0, fragile, unblocker for canary migrations
Priya Nair, platform-engineering, us-east, 11:00-15:00 EST, infra, 2029-07-11, 2.0, healthy, owns autoscaler tuning knobs
Ethan Morales, serving-runtime, us-west, 22:00-02:00 PDT, night-cover, 2029-07-08, 96.0, stale, backup liaison when Marcus OOO
Sofia Patel, console-and-tooling, eu-west, 09:00-13:00 CEST, console, 2029-07-12, 0.25, priority, dashboard owner and trace hook contact
Ravi Singh, observability, apac, 11:00-15:00 IST, sampling, 2029-07-05, 84.0, fragile, sampling config change pending PR

Light-score explanation: quick heuristic to prioritize outreach. Score = (timeliness_component + coverage_component + freshness_component) where each component is 0-100 and we report average. Practical implementation in sheet: 
- timeliness_component = max(0, 100 - ResponseLagHrs) capped to [0,100] (i.e., smaller lag => higher score)
- coverage_component = 100 if CoverageType in [full-route, liaison, infra], 70 for telemetry/console, 40 for customer-bridge/night-cover
- freshness_component = 100 if RecentPing within 7 days, 50 if within 30 days, 10 otherwise

Current quick calc snapshot (manual sample from rows above):
- Count rows = 10
- Timeliness raw scores (approx): Marcus(98.5), Leah(94), Anika(99.5), Tom(28), Maya(0), Jia(52), Priya(98), Ethan(4), Sofia(99.75), Ravi(16) -> average ~59.2
- Coverage component average ~82 (mix of full-route/liaison/infra + some lower types)
- Freshness average ~65 (mix of recent and stale)
- Light-score (avg of components) ~68 (rounded).

Interpretation: overall compact triage score ~68/100 -> fair but several stale/fragile rows pull it down. Immediate actions focus on rows with CurrentFlag in [stale, fragile] and ResponseLagHrs > 48.

Action items (rapid):
- Maya Ortiz: add new rotation owner for private-deployments (due 2029-07-15)
- Tom Becker: confirm APAC pilot coverage or mark customer-bridge as delegated (due 2029-07-14)
- Ethan Morales: confirm backup availability or remove from active list (due 2029-07-16)
- Marcus Chen & Leah Kline: run quick sweep tomorrow morning; update RecentPing column after pings (due 2029-07-13 morning)

Notes: keep this sheet intentionally minimal. If headcount increases, migrate to the canonical liaison directory (link above) and bump to ProductOps weekly review. This file is an ad-hoc snapshot to be archived after the next rotation update.

Version notes: created during post-incident fast retro; will convert to a short Confluence digest if action items exceed 3.
